mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_dataset (dataset_id, dataset_name, description, item_count, items_json, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{datasetId}, #{datasetName}, #{description}, #{itemCount}, #{itemsJson}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, dataset_id, dataset_name, description, item_count, items_json, create_time, update_time FROM eval_dataset WHERE dataset_id = #{datasetId}
SELECT id, dataset_id, dataset_name, description, item_count, create_time, update_time FROM eval_dataset ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
